metadata.name: Software Development Flow
metadata.description: Task-first software development with source-grounded planning, independent semantic review, impact-based validation, conditional visual reports, accepted-unit VCS checkpoints, and repository-grounded final coverage.
metadata.author: mcp-moira-team

nodes.directive: Capture the user's development task and authority before task-specific discovery or repository mutation. Read all standing project instructions. Create ./moira-ws/{task-name}-{YYYYMMDD}-{HHMM}/ and treat it as the new workspace throughout this directive; do not use workspace_path before returning it. Inside that workspace, write this execution ID to process-id.txt and keep task-requirements.md as the single canonical requirements source. Resolve every explicitly assigned ticket, pull request, issue, specification, or document through available project-native mechanisms; preserve its identity, retrieval location, and complete current content in durable source files without preliminary relevance filtering, then separately incorporate all authoritative requirements without reducing them to a lossy summary. If a source cannot be obtained, expose that blocker instead of planning without it. Before mutation, inspect project-native VCS read-only and record VCS kind, branch or bookmark, status, relevant diff/baseline, unrelated changes to preserve, and already authorized side effects in vcs-baseline.md without assuming Git or requiring a clean tree. Discover task-relevant entry points, interfaces and data flow, implementations, dependencies and consumers, tests and fixtures, coverage policy/maps, documentation, configuration and schemas, generated artifacts, project-native commands, build/environment/health, runtime/integration surfaces, UI/browser architecture, CI/review/checklists, ownership boundaries, and applicable security/performance constraints. Record exact locations/evidence or a justified N/A in project-context.md. Use additional project-native searches when one search is insufficient; never conclude that an artifact or dependency does not exist from one superficial search. Ask only for a material fact that cannot be discovered. Do not create permanent guides merely because one is absent, and do not mutate the repository here. Return the new workspace path as workspace_path.
nodes.completionCondition: Task, authority, assigned sources, canonical requirements, read-only VCS baseline, correlated workspace, and relevant project context are durably captured before mutation

nodes.directive: Present the complete current requirements at {{workspace_path}}/task-requirements.md and ask whether they accurately capture the task, constraints, authority, and acceptance criteria. Read the file when exact current content is not already available or may have changed. Do not edit it here. On rejection, save the user's verbatim feedback to {{workspace_path}}/requirements-feedback.md.
nodes.completionCondition: The user approved the current requirements or supplied actionable feedback

nodes.directive: Use the verbatim feedback in {{workspace_path}}/requirements-feedback.md to update {{workspace_path}}/task-requirements.md. Preserve every unaffected requirement and authority boundary, resolve conflicts with the user when necessary, and keep one canonical requirements source. Do not create a parallel summary.
nodes.completionCondition: Canonical requirements incorporate the feedback without losing unaffected requirements

nodes.directive: Determine whether initial project-health evidence is relevant to the approved task. Use project-native instructions and the task-relevant context already captured; a missing guide is not permission to skip applicable checks. When relevant, run the smallest startup and baseline-test checks that establish a truthful starting state. Write {{workspace_path}}/project-health.md with exact commands, outcomes, and classification. Distinguish a healthy state, inapplicability, unrelated pre-existing failure, repository failure that this task must resolve before development, and an external blocker requiring changed state.
nodes.completionCondition: Applicable baseline evidence and a truthful classified outcome exist in project-health.md

nodes.directive: Present the external blocker from {{workspace_path}}/project-health.md. Ask the user to confirm that external state changed before retrying, or to abort. Do not retry on an unchanged environment. If aborting, ensure the health report contains the current blocker and partial-work facts.
nodes.completionCondition: The user confirmed changed external state or chose to abort

nodes.directive: Create the current material plan revision at {{workspace_path}}/plans/{{plan_revision}}/plan.md from the canonical requirements, resolved assigned sources, task-relevant project evidence, VCS baseline, and actual repository contracts. Define independently completable outcome-oriented units with affected responsibilities and boundaries, dependencies and ordering, contracts and invariants, observable acceptance evidence, expected task-owned files, applicable tests and coverage-map updates, permanent documentation, security/performance/runtime/UI obligations, risks, and unresolved decisions. Map every affected or at-risk behavior to automated evidence or a justified manual check. Explicitly mark each unit that requires screenshot capture, actual visual inspection, and a self-contained step-report.html; do not infer or add that obligation later merely because a UI file changed. Record the requested project-native authority for checkpoint commits after accepted units and final reconciliation. Preserve executor freedom over exploration, decomposition details, tools, edit order, and repair tactics unless a real external contract constrains them.
nodes.completionCondition: A complete outcome-oriented current plan revision exists with observable evidence, conditional visual-report obligations, and requested VCS authority

nodes.directive: Review {{workspace_path}}/plans/{{plan_revision}}/plan.md independently against the complete canonical requirements, every assigned primary source, standing project instructions, relevant repository architecture and behavior, VCS/side-effect boundaries, and prior completed work. Use a separate reviewer context or subagent when the host supports it; otherwise perform a fresh self-review and disclose that fallback in the report. Read primary artifacts directly when they are not already available or may have changed. Verify requirements coverage, dependencies, writer/reader contracts, executable routes, test and documentation obligations, task-file ownership, checkpoint authority, and observable evidence. Reject an unjustified omission of screenshot/visual/HTML evidence when the outcome cannot be adequately accepted without it. Overwrite {{workspace_path}}/plans/{{plan_revision}}/review.md with the complete set of reproducible blocking defects detectable at the earliest sufficient review tier. For every blocker give the exact location, violated contract, observable consequence, and concrete correction. Do not stop after the first finding and do not block on formatting taste, fixed step counts, or speculative redesign. Return only the count of all current blocking findings; zero is valid.
nodes.completionCondition: The complete current independent plan review exists, discloses reviewer independence or fallback, and its count matches all blocking findings

nodes.directive: Repair the current plan revision using {{workspace_path}}/plans/{{plan_revision}}/review.md. Reproduce each blocking defect, correct the root cause in the plan, preserve still-valid decisions and executor freedom, and update the same plan artifact. Do not implement style suggestions or create review bookkeeping.
nodes.completionCondition: The current plan revision changed to address every reproduced blocking defect

nodes.directive: Present the complete reviewed plan revision at {{workspace_path}}/plans/{{plan_revision}}/plan.md with its architecture, outcomes, dependencies, evidence obligations, conditional visual-report units, risks, and side effects. Ask for explicit plan approval and one explicit project-native VCS authority that covers both checkpoint commits after accepted units and final reconciliation. Write {{workspace_path}}/plans/{{plan_revision}}/approval.md with the decision and, on approval, the exact approved cursor, bound, and commit authority. On approval, derive the next uncompleted 1-based plan-unit index and total unit count from this exact revision and return them with vcs_commits_authorized. On rejection, also save verbatim feedback to {{workspace_path}}/plans/{{plan_revision}}/user-feedback.md. Do not edit the plan or mutate VCS here.
nodes.completionCondition: The user decision, approved cursor and bound, conditional evidence obligations, and checkpoint/final VCS authority or rejection feedback are durable

nodes.directive: Create the next material plan revision from {{workspace_path}}/plans/{{plan_revision}}/plan.md and the verbatim rejection at {{workspace_path}}/plans/{{plan_revision}}/user-feedback.md. Increment plan_revision, preserve the rejected revision, carry forward unaffected requirements and completed work, and write the new plan under the new revision directory. Do not create a summary relay.
nodes.completionCondition: A new material plan revision incorporates the user's rejection feedback

nodes.directive: Implement approved plan unit {{current_step_index}} of {{total_steps}} from {{workspace_path}}/plans/{{plan_revision}}/plan.md. Use the complete current plan when not already available or when it may have changed. Own the complete approved outcome: inspect real dependencies and surrounding contracts, change the repository, preserve unrelated work, add or update necessary tests and coverage artifacts, update applicable permanent documentation, and run useful focused checks. Inventory every changed or at-risk behavior and contract and map it to concrete automated evidence or an explicit manual verification reason. Write one concise reproducible report to {{workspace_path}}/step-{{current_step_index}}/iteration-{{current_iteration}}/implementation.md in this turn with task-owned changed files, commands and outcomes, behavior/evidence mappings, documentation impact, unresolved facts, and unrelated changes that must remain excluded. Do not commit or publish here.
nodes.completionCondition: The complete approved unit, dependencies, task-owned changes, tests, docs, behavior inventory, focused evidence, and reproducible implementation report are current

nodes.directive: Inspect the actual repository changes for plan unit {{current_step_index}}, standing project instructions, the approved outcome, current implementation report, and affected behavior inventory. Run the smallest project-native deterministic checks that diagnose the affected scope; this mechanical gate does not require a separate reviewer context. Explicitly consider formatting, lint, static analysis, scoped type checking or compilation, targeted/unit tests, need for new or changed tests and coverage-map updates, permanent documentation, public contracts, shared schemas/configuration, migrations, concurrency, generated artifacts, infrastructure, and project checklists. For every applicable area provide exact evidence; for every materially plausible omitted area give a concrete N/A reason. Overwrite {{workspace_path}}/step-{{current_step_index}}/iteration-{{current_iteration}}/cheap-validation.md with commands/outcomes and every reproducible repository defect. Do not rerun broad checks whose evidence is current, and do not treat unrelated or external failures as success. Return only the blocking issue count.
nodes.completionCondition: Current independent cheap-validation evidence covers every materially applicable affected area and its issue count matches reproducible repository defects

nodes.directive: Use the current cheap-validation report to reproduce and repair every repository-caused blocking defect at its root. Preserve unrelated changes and do not absorb unrelated or external failures. Never obtain a pass by weakening tests, assertions, schemas, types, lint, coverage, or another quality gate; change a validator or test only with concrete proof that its expectation is obsolete. Do not add sleeps, force, blind retries, swallowed errors, suppression, or timeout inflation. Create the next numeric evidence iteration for plan unit {{current_step_index}}, write repair evidence and the updated implementation report there, return that new number as current_iteration, and run focused evidence before independent revalidation.
nodes.completionCondition: Repository content changed to repair reproduced cheap-validation defects

nodes.directive: In an independent reviewer context where supported, compare the actual changes for plan unit {{current_step_index}} with the approved behavior inventory, tests, project coverage maps and thresholds, standing test rules, and current validation evidence; disclose fallback self-review otherwise. Inspect changed and at-risk behavior, boundaries, contracts, schemas, configuration, integrations, regression risks, concurrency, migrations, and failure paths rather than using function or assertion counts. Verify that tests exercise observable production behavior, would fail on the relevant regression, and are not duplicated across levels without purpose. Overwrite {{workspace_path}}/step-{{current_step_index}}/iteration-{{current_iteration}}/test-adequacy-review.md with the complete set of blockers detectable at this earliest sufficient tier. For every blocker give exact location, violated contract, observable consequence, and concrete correction; do not stop after the first. Return only the complete issue count; zero is valid.
nodes.completionCondition: Independent test-adequacy review covers actual changed and at-risk behavior, discloses fallback when needed, and its count matches blocking findings

nodes.directive: Use the current test-adequacy report to reproduce every confirmed gap and repair the production behavior, necessary tests, implementation seams, and coverage maps at their root. Preserve unrelated changes. Never obtain a pass by weakening tests, assertions, schemas, types, lint, coverage, or another quality gate; change a validator or existing expectation only with concrete proof that it is obsolete. Do not add sleeps, force, blind retries, swallowed errors, suppression, or timeout inflation, and do not absorb unrelated failures. Create the next numeric evidence iteration for plan unit {{current_step_index}}, write repair evidence and the updated implementation report there, return that new number as current_iteration, and run focused evidence before independent revalidation.
nodes.completionCondition: Repository content changed to repair all reproduced test-adequacy defects

nodes.directive: In an independent reviewer context where supported, review the actual implementation for plan unit {{current_step_index}} against canonical requirements, the approved plan, standing instructions, assigned architectural sources, surrounding project code, behavior evidence, and current test evidence; disclose fallback self-review otherwise. Check conformance with established project and broadly accepted patterns, responsibility separation, cohesion/coupling, dependency direction, contracts and invariants, justified abstractions, extensibility and evidenced scalability, deterministic test seams, maintainability, lifecycle and error handling, plus applicable security/performance/UI concerns. Overwrite {{workspace_path}}/step-{{current_step_index}}/iteration-{{current_iteration}}/architecture-review.md with the complete set of blockers detectable at this earliest sufficient tier. For every blocker give exact location, violated contract, observable consequence, and concrete correction; do not stop after the first. Set requires_replan only when the approved plan itself cannot produce a correct result, including when newly proven visual acceptance is necessary but the unit lacks the approved screenshot/HTML obligation. Do not constrain implementation with speculative design or aesthetic preference; zero findings is valid.
nodes.completionCondition: Independent architecture review is project-grounded, discloses fallback when needed, and has an accurate issue count and replan decision

nodes.directive: Use the current architecture review and any current closure feedback to reproduce and repair every confirmed defect that can be resolved within the approved plan. Correct root causes in code, tests, or documentation; preserve valid project patterns and unrelated changes; do not implement speculative suggestions or absorb unrelated failures into task scope. Never obtain a pass by weakening tests, assertions, schemas, types, lint, architecture constraints, or another quality gate; change a validator or test only with concrete proof that it is obsolete. Do not add sleeps, force, blind retries, swallowed errors, suppression, or timeout inflation. Create the next numeric evidence iteration for plan unit {{current_step_index}}, write repair evidence and the updated implementation report there, return that new number as current_iteration, and run focused evidence before independent revalidation.
nodes.completionCondition: Repository content changed to repair reproduced architecture defects within the approved plan

nodes.directive: The architecture review proves that the approved plan must change. Present what plan unit {{current_step_index}} completed, what remains, why the plan cannot be completed correctly, and how unfinished work would be carried forward. Ask whether the current unit may be closed for a new plan revision. Save the explicit decision and verbatim feedback to {{workspace_path}}/plans/{{plan_revision}}/closure-feedback.md. Do not revise the plan here.
nodes.completionCondition: The user explicitly approved or refused closure with durable feedback

nodes.directive: Create the next material plan revision using the current approved plan, actual completed work, the architecture review, and {{workspace_path}}/plans/{{plan_revision}}/closure-feedback.md. Increment plan_revision, preserve prior revisions, close only the user-approved current unit, and carry every unfinished outcome into the next uncompleted units. Keep completed work immutable and executor tactics open.
nodes.completionCondition: A new material plan revision correctly carries unfinished work after approved closure

nodes.directive: Determine runtime, browser, checklist, security, and performance applicability from canonical requirements, the approved plan unit, project policy, actual diff, changed/at-risk behavior inventory, and current evidence. Screenshot validation is applicable only when this exact approved plan unit explicitly requires screenshot capture, actual visual inspection, and step-report.html; incidental UI impact cannot enable it here. Execute every applicable project checklist item and record PASS with evidence, N/A with reason, or FAIL with location and correction. For applicable UI behavior, cover representative affected states and dependent behavior with project-native browser evidence. When screenshots are required, capture every required state, open the actual images with available visual capability, compare expected and observed behavior, and record the assessment; file existence alone is not evidence and unfinished capture/inspection means this directive is not complete. Write {{workspace_path}}/step-{{current_step_index}}/iteration-{{current_iteration}}/runtime-validation.md with behavior-to-evidence mappings. Classify reproducible application or permanent project-native capture/tooling defects as repository_failure and unavailable external browser/vision infrastructure as external_blocker. Do not repeat deterministic checks that cannot diagnose runtime behavior.
nodes.completionCondition: All applicable runtime and checklist work is complete; any required screenshots were captured, opened, and visually assessed; evidence and classification are truthful

nodes.directive: Use the current runtime-validation report to reproduce and repair repository-caused runtime or specialized-check failures at their root. Change production code, tests, capture tooling, or documentation only as justified and preserve unrelated work. Never obtain a pass by weakening tests, assertions, schemas, types, lint, visual expectations, security/performance gates, or another quality gate; change a validator or test only with concrete proof that it is obsolete. Do not add sleeps, force, blind retries, swallowed errors, suppression, or timeout inflation, and do not absorb unrelated or external failures. Create the next numeric evidence iteration for plan unit {{current_step_index}}, write repair evidence and the updated implementation report there, return that new number as current_iteration, and run focused evidence before independent revalidation.
nodes.completionCondition: Repository content changed to repair reproduced runtime defects

nodes.directive: Present the concrete external blocker from the current runtime-validation report. Ask the user to confirm changed external state before retrying, or to abort. Do not retry unchanged.
nodes.completionCondition: The user confirmed changed state or chose abort

nodes.directive: After cheaper mutating and semantic gates have converged, decide whether a broad or expensive build, test, integration, runtime, or packaging check is required by project policy, affected contracts, or actual risk for plan unit {{current_step_index}}. Reuse equivalent current evidence when no later mutation can affect it; do not repeat a full suite mechanically on every iteration. Run applicable project-native checks and write {{workspace_path}}/step-{{current_step_index}}/iteration-{{current_iteration}}/expensive-validation.md with exact commands and outcomes, evidence scope, or a concrete inapplicability reason. Classify reproducible repository failures separately from external blockers and never hide partial or failed results as pass.
nodes.completionCondition: Applicable non-stale expensive evidence or justified inapplicability exists with truthful classification

nodes.directive: Use the current expensive-validation report to reproduce and repair every repository-caused failure at its root. Preserve unrelated work and do not broaden to unrelated or external failures. Never obtain a pass by weakening tests, assertions, schemas, types, lint, build/integration gates, or another quality gate; change a validator or test only with concrete proof that it is obsolete. Do not add sleeps, force, blind retries, swallowed errors, suppression, or timeout inflation. Create the next numeric evidence iteration for plan unit {{current_step_index}}, write repair evidence and the updated implementation report there, return that new number as current_iteration, and run focused evidence before returning through all stale cheaper and semantic gates.
nodes.completionCondition: Repository content changed to repair reproduced expensive-validation failures

nodes.directive: Present the concrete external blocker from the current expensive-validation report. Ask the user to confirm changed external state before retrying, or to abort. Do not retry unchanged.
nodes.completionCondition: The user confirmed changed state or chose abort

nodes.directive: Determine from the approved plan, task authority, and material impact whether plan unit {{current_step_index}} requires user acceptance. If this exact approved unit requires screenshots and step-report.html, create or regenerate {{workspace_path}}/step-{{current_step_index}}/step-report.html from the current stabilized implementation, runtime, screenshot, review, and expensive-validation evidence. Make it a portable self-contained HTML document with embedded styling and no external runtime dependency, responsive readability, explicit PASS/FAIL/warning states, factual language without marketing claims, and embedded images or reliable relative paths that remain valid from the documented location. State outcome, affected behavior, scenarios, commands/tests/reviews, limitations, expected versus observed screenshot assessments with honest baseline handling, and concise manual-verification instructions. Open or otherwise verify the final document and its image references, then present or link that exact report and request approval in the same substantive turn. For such a unit, skip is forbidden. If no visual-report obligation exists, do not create screenshot HTML; present concise behavior and exact verification evidence when user acceptance is materially required, otherwise use skip. Write the decision and cited evidence to {{workspace_path}}/step-{{current_step_index}}/acceptance.md. On rejection, also save verbatim feedback to {{workspace_path}}/step-{{current_step_index}}/user-feedback.md. Do not repair here.
nodes.completionCondition: The applicable acceptance decision and evidence are durable; required current HTML is presented and accepted or rejected without skip; verbatim rejection feedback exists when needed

nodes.directive: Use the verbatim plan-unit feedback at {{workspace_path}}/step-{{current_step_index}}/user-feedback.md and the current approved plan to resolve the rejection at its correct authority boundary. If feedback identifies an in-plan defect, reproduce and repair its root cause while preserving unrelated changes and without absorbing unrelated failures into task scope. Never obtain acceptance by weakening tests, assertions, schemas, types, lint, visual evidence, or another quality gate; change a validator or test only with concrete proof that it is obsolete. Do not add sleeps, force, blind retries, swallowed errors, suppression, or timeout inflation. Run the smallest project-native check that proves the in-plan repair, create the next numeric evidence iteration, write that focused evidence and the updated implementation report there, and return resolution=in_plan with the new current_iteration. If feedback materially changes requirements, architecture, or approved outcomes, do not implement the unapproved change: update canonical requirements, create the next material plan revision, increment plan_revision, preserve prior revisions and completed work, and return resolution=replan with the new plan_revision. Perform the chosen substantive action in this turn; do not add an analyzer or relay.
nodes.completionCondition: The rejection was resolved by a changed in-plan implementation or a new material plan revision

nodes.directive: Present the concrete external finalization blocker from {{workspace_path}}/finalization.md. Ask whether external state has changed and now permits retry, whether to skip the already-authorized finalization without altering verified repository content, or whether to abort. Do not rerun unrelated validation and do not retry unchanged state.
nodes.completionCondition: The user chose retry after changed external state, skip, or abort

nodes.directive: Reconcile permanent project documentation against the complete requirements, assigned sources, approved plan revisions, actual repository behavior, project documentation rules, and documentation already changed by implementation units. Determine whether documentation is affected even when it is already current and no new edit is needed. Change only genuinely stale affected sections; keep content factual and current-state, omit marketing claims and development history unless explicitly required, do not add unsupported claims, and do not create a new long-lived document without a durable reader need. Include required commands, examples, contracts, generated output, links, rendering, language parity, and coverage-map updates. Write {{workspace_path}}/documentation-reconciliation.md with exact evidence. Return change_scope=not_applicable only with a concrete reason, documentation_affected whenever any task documentation exists or changed (whether or not this turn edits it), or executable when executable/generated documentation changes repository behavior. For executable mutation, create the next numeric evidence iteration for the current plan unit and return it as current_iteration; otherwise do not change current_iteration.
nodes.completionCondition: Documentation applicability and current affected state are factual; every affected state is routed to independent review and executable mutations re-enter code gates

nodes.directive: In an independent reviewer context where supported, validate every task-affected permanent documentation state against actual repository behavior, canonical requirements, assigned sources, project documentation rules, affected-section scope, links, examples, commands, rendering, generated output, required language parity, and coverage-map obligations; disclose fallback self-review otherwise. Reject marketing language, development history not explicitly requested, unsupported claims, stale or duplicated content, and a new long-lived document without a durable reader need. Overwrite {{workspace_path}}/documentation-review.md with the complete set of blockers detectable at this earliest sufficient tier. For every blocker give exact location, violated contract, observable consequence, and concrete correction; do not stop after the first. Return only the complete issue count; zero is valid and unrelated product-wide checks are not required.
nodes.completionCondition: Every affected documentation state has complete independent current evidence and the issue count matches all reproducible blockers

nodes.directive: Use {{workspace_path}}/documentation-review.md to reproduce and repair every confirmed documentation defect at its root. Keep changes factual, current-state, scoped to affected sections, and consistent with actual behavior; preserve unrelated work and do not create a new long-lived document without durable need. Run project-native documentation checks and update the reconciliation evidence. Never obtain a pass by weakening tests, assertions, schemas, types, lint, links, rendering, parity, or another quality gate; change a validator or test only with concrete proof that its expectation is obsolete. Do not use sleeps, force, blind retry, swallowed errors, suppression, or timeout inflation, and do not absorb unrelated failures.
nodes.completionCondition: Documentation changed to repair every reproduced defect

nodes.directive: At the final stable boundary, decide whether project policy or the complete change risk requires feature-wide compilation, tests, integration, runtime, or other broad evidence not already current. Run only applicable project-native checks and write {{workspace_path}}/feature-validation.md with exact outcomes or a concrete inapplicability reason. Classify repository failures separately from external blockers; do not run expensive multi-trial agent evals.
nodes.completionCondition: Applicable feature-wide evidence or justified inapplicability exists with truthful classification

nodes.directive: Use {{workspace_path}}/feature-validation.md to reproduce and repair repository-caused feature-wide failures at their root. Preserve unrelated changes and do not absorb external or unrelated failures. Never obtain a pass by weakening tests, assertions, schemas, types, lint, build/integration gates, or another quality gate; change a validator or test only with concrete proof that it is obsolete. Do not add sleeps, force, blind retries, swallowed errors, suppression, or timeout inflation. Create the next numeric evidence iteration for the current plan unit, write repair evidence and the updated implementation report there, return that new number as current_iteration, run focused evidence, and return through every stale unit gate.
nodes.completionCondition: Repository content changed to repair reproduced feature-wide failures

nodes.directive: Present the concrete external blocker in {{workspace_path}}/feature-validation.md. Ask the user to confirm changed external state before retrying, or to abort. Do not retry unchanged.
nodes.completionCondition: The user confirmed changed state or chose abort

nodes.directive: In an independent reviewer context where supported, review the complete final repository state against all confirmed requirements, assigned primary sources, approved plan revisions, standing project instructions, architecture decisions, tests, permanent documentation, coverage artifacts, unit checkpoints, and current validation evidence; disclose fallback self-review otherwise. Inspect actual code and surrounding project patterns. Verify cross-unit contracts, responsibility boundaries, maintainability, test adequacy, current documentation, preserved unrelated work, and that every conditional visual obligation has current inspected evidence and its accepted report. Overwrite {{workspace_path}}/final-semantic-review.md with the complete set of blockers detectable at this earliest sufficient tier. For every blocker give exact location, violated contract, observable consequence, and concrete correction; do not stop after the first. Return only the complete issue count; zero is valid and speculative redesign is not blocking.
nodes.completionCondition: Complete independent final semantic review exists, discloses fallback when needed, and its count matches all blocking findings

nodes.directive: Use {{workspace_path}}/final-semantic-review.md to reproduce and repair every confirmed final defect at its root. Change code, tests, or documentation as required and preserve unrelated work. Never obtain a pass by weakening tests, assertions, schemas, types, lint, architecture/documentation rules, or another quality gate; change a validator or test only with concrete proof that it is obsolete. Do not add sleeps, force, blind retries, swallowed errors, suppression, or timeout inflation, and do not absorb unrelated failures. Create the next numeric evidence iteration for the current plan unit, write repair evidence and the updated implementation report there, return that new number as current_iteration, run focused evidence, and return through every stale gate.
nodes.completionCondition: Repository content changed to repair every reproduced final semantic defect

nodes.directive: Verify every confirmed requirement and acceptance criterion against the final repository, documentation, tests, and current evidence. Inspect cited code and tests directly; do not launch another workflow or use task/function counts as a proxy. Overwrite {{workspace_path}}/requirements-coverage.md with one requirement per section, COVERED or GAP, and concrete implementation/test evidence or a justified non-automated check. Return only the gap count.
nodes.completionCondition: Every requirement has current repository and test evidence or a concrete gap; the count matches the report

nodes.directive: Create the next material plan revision from the current approved plan and {{workspace_path}}/requirements-coverage.md. Increment plan_revision, preserve prior revisions and completed work, and add only the outcomes required to close every concrete coverage gap with appropriate tests/docs/evidence. Keep executor tactics open.
nodes.completionCondition: A new material plan revision addresses every final coverage gap

nodes.directive: Create {{workspace_path}}/final-report.md from the exact current requirements, assigned sources, approved plan revisions, unit implementation reports, checkpoint reports, validation evidence, final semantic review, requirements coverage, documentation reconciliation, and user decisions. State implemented behavior, architecture-relevant outcomes, task-owned files, exact commands and outcomes, automated and manual verification, accepted visual reports where applicable, limitations, and every item that is not implemented, postponed, excluded, unrelated, or externally blocked. Do not copy large diagnostics. Present this current report and ask whether the complete repository result is accepted before any feature-level VCS reconciliation. On rejection, save verbatim feedback to {{workspace_path}}/final-user-feedback.md. Do not repair or mutate VCS here.
nodes.completionCondition: A current factual final report exists and the user accepted the repository result before VCS reconciliation or supplied actionable rejection feedback

nodes.directive: Update canonical requirements from {{workspace_path}}/final-user-feedback.md without duplicating or contradicting unaffected requirements. Create the next material plan revision, increment plan_revision, preserve prior revisions and completed work, and add outcomes needed to address the concrete dissatisfaction with tests/docs/evidence. Keep executor tactics open.
nodes.completionCondition: Requirements and a new material plan revision incorporate the user's final rejection feedback

nodes.directive: Reconcile the complete user-accepted repository state only within the project-native commit authority recorded in the current approved plan revision. Discover and follow native VCS and pre-commit conventions; do not assume Git, GitHub, gh, branch creation, or a clean tree. Preserve existing checkpoint history without squash, amend, rebase, or other automatic rewriting. Include only remaining task-owned changes created after or intentionally excluded from the last unit checkpoint, such as late documentation or rework; exclude unrelated changes and {{workspace_path}} artifacts. If checkpoints already cover the accepted state, record a truthful successful no-op. Write {{workspace_path}}/finalization.md with plan_revision={{plan_revision}}, current_step_index={{current_step_index}}, current_iteration={{current_iteration}}, the exact included scope, actual outcome, revision identifier when created, or concrete blocker. Classify pass, repository_failure requiring repository repair, or external_blocker requiring changed state or a user decision.
nodes.completionCondition: Authorized final reconciliation succeeded or no-op, or a concrete current blocker with exact coordinates is durably classified

nodes.directive: Repair the current repository-caused VCS failure at its root. Select {{workspace_path}}/checkpoints/plan-{{plan_revision}}/step-{{current_step_index}}/iteration-{{current_iteration}}/checkpoint.md only when it records repository_failure for exactly plan_revision={{plan_revision}}, current_step_index={{current_step_index}}, current_iteration={{current_iteration}}; otherwise select {{workspace_path}}/finalization.md only when it records the matching current repository_failure. Exactly one source must match: no match or multiple matches is a workflow contract defect and must not enter an unchanged repair loop. Reproduce the selected defect, preserve unrelated work, and do not absorb policy, external blockers, or unrelated repository failures into task scope. Never obtain a pass by weakening tests, assertions, schemas, types, lint, pre-commit checks, or another quality gate; change a validator or test only with concrete proof that it is obsolete. Do not add sleeps, force, blind retries, swallowed errors, suppression, or timeout inflation. Create the next numeric evidence iteration for the current plan unit, write repair evidence naming the selected source and checkpoint/final scope plus the updated implementation report there without copying findings into workflow context, and return that new number as current_iteration. Run focused evidence, then return through every stale repository, semantic, runtime, acceptance, checkpoint, documentation, coverage, and finalization gate.
nodes.completionCondition: Exactly one current VCS failure source was selected and repository content changed to repair the reproduced defect

nodes.directive: Create the authorized project-native checkpoint for completed plan unit {{current_step_index}} only after its implementation, all applicable validation, and conditional user acceptance are current. Inspect the VCS baseline, approved unit, actual diff, and current evidence. Follow native VCS and pre-commit conventions without assuming Git, GitHub, gh, branch changes, or a clean tree. Include only task-owned changes attributable to this unit; exclude unrelated changes and {{workspace_path}} artifacts. Do not stash, reset, clean, squash, amend, rebase, or rewrite history. If there is no task-owned change to record, succeed without an empty revision. Write {{workspace_path}}/checkpoints/plan-{{plan_revision}}/step-{{current_step_index}}/iteration-{{current_iteration}}/checkpoint.md with plan_revision={{plan_revision}}, current_step_index={{current_step_index}}, current_iteration={{current_iteration}}, exact included scope, actual outcome, revision identifier when created, or the concrete defect/blocker. A repository or pre-commit defect returns repository_failure. For an external blocker, ask in this same responsibility to retry only after changed external state, explicitly skip this checkpoint, or abort; return pass after an explicit skip and abort after abort. Do not add retry counters or status globals.
nodes.completionCondition: The authorized unit checkpoint succeeded or no-op/explicit skip is durably recorded, or a concrete repository failure or abort is truthfully classified

total_steps.description: Executable unit count from the current approved plan

vcs_commits_authorized.description: Explicit authority for project-native per-unit checkpoint commits and final reconciliation
